_comment: Single source of the reasoning controls of each model family, independent of the provider that serves it. A model id is normalized (lowercase, last path segment, an Ollama :tag dropped) and matched against each family's globs (* is the only wildcard); the first family wins. Its controls are tried in order and the first control kind the provider's dialect carries applies (api_providers.json thinking_dialect: kind -> body fields, $level replaced by the control's level); a family with no control, or a provider without that kind, sends nothing. intent off turns thinking off; lowest is the lowest level when the family cannot turn it off. A family with default_sampling_only true accepts only the default sampling: the drivers send it no temperature (Anthropic answers HTTP 400 to any other value on these models). Kinds: toggle (hybrid models: on or off), effort (reasoning_effort scale), anthropic_thinking, anthropic_effort, gemini_budget, gemini_level. Local servers turn thinking off for every model through local_servers.json request_fields, and their thinking_dialect adds a family's level on top. Every Ollama chat body sends think from the family's first control Ollama carries: a toggle or an off intent sends false, an effort level listed in ollama_think_levels sends that level (gpt-oss ignores think false and takes low: docs.ollama.com/capabilities/thinking), anything else (no family, no such control) sends false. A provider answering HTTP 400 that names an injected field gets the request once more without it, and that field is remembered as refused for that provider and model, across restarts (at most 200 pairs), until refusal_expiry_days pass, so a later provider fix is picked up. Resolved by _shared/lua/llm/thinking_off.lua and _shared/modules/llm/thinking_off.ahk, pinned by _shared/tests/corpus/llm/thinking_off_vectors.json. Sources checked 2026-10-30.

families._family: Claude Opus 5.5, Fable 5, Mythos 5: thinking cannot be disabled, low is the lowest effort
Claude Sonnet 5.5: between_tools is the lowest thinking setting
Claude Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Haiku 5.5: thinking off (Claude 4.x and older think only when asked)
Claude Opus 4.7 and 4.8: no thinking rule (off unless asked), and only the default sampling
GPT-6: none and minimal are refused
GPT-5 pro, codex and chat models: no documented reasoning_effort on chat completions
GPT-5.1 and later: none turns reasoning off
GPT-5: minimal is the lowest effort
o-series: low is the lowest effort
gpt-oss safeguard: no documented reasoning_effort
gpt-oss: reasoning cannot be disabled, low is the lowest effort
Gemini 2.5 Flash image, speech and audio models: no documented thinking
Gemini 2.5 Flash and Flash-Lite: thinkingBudget 0 disables thinking
Gemini 2.5 Pro: thinking cannot be disabled, 128 is the lowest budget
Gemini 3 Flash models that accept minimal
Gemini 3 Pro, gemini-3.8-flash and Gemini 4: low is the lowest level
Grok 4.3: none turns reasoning off
Grok 4.5 to 4.7: reasoning cannot be disabled
Grok 3 mini: low is the lowest effort (unverified: not on the current models page)
Mistral Small 2603 and Medium 3.5: none turns reasoning off
Mistral Large 4.0: none is refused
GLM served as zai-glm: none is refused, low is the lowest
GLM 4.5 and later: hybrid, thinking can be turned off
Kimi K3: hybrid on Together; on Cerebras none is refused
Always-reasoning models: nothing turns them off
MiniMax M3: hybrid on Together
Qwen3, Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6: hybrid, thinking can be turned off
DeepSeek V3.1 and later, deepseek-flash: hybrid, thinking can be turned off
Hermes 4: hybrid, thinking can be turned off
Generic: an unknown model whose name looks like a reasoning family gets thinking off through the provider's toggle (a field the provider refuses is dropped and remembered, see _comment)
